original.statement: A new password field is added to PKCS#12 and JKS keystores in the Certificate resource, allowing passwords to be specified as literal strings, mutually exclusive with the existing passwordSecretRef field.

decision.reason: [ev-4c3d690d4f9d] describes an optional new literal `password` field for the Certificate `keystores` feature, as an alternative to `passwordSecretRef`. It names no failure for existing configurations. The CRD diff [ev-60054fcf0986][ev-84061d76ea1b] confirms that `spec.keystores.jks.password` and `spec.keystores.pkcs12.password` are newly added. The consequence is none, so the only environments the change touches are those that already have Certificates with `spec.keystores` set. The proposed condition expresses exactly that, without claiming mandatory work. P4's narrower `passwordSecretRef` condition comes to roughly the same thing, because in the prior release keystores carried their password through `passwordSecretRef`.
